annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage by inviting viewers to join a down-line, purchase initial platforms, and pay 0.05 ETH plus gas through a wallet-based registration flow. It presents escalating ETH-priced levels and referral-based earnings, including claims that viewers can receive partner payments and earn many ethers by sharing a link. Decentralization, transparency, and no-scam assurances, along with a closing risk reminder, do not negate the invitation to register, pay ETH, and build referrals for promised crypto earnings.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central mechanism is a paid referral matrix, not an ordinary one-level referral offer: participants purchase sequential platforms, occupy structured places, and are told that partner payments depend on their own corresponding platform being open. Reinvestment is described as reopening platforms, and viewers are encouraged to build a referral structure.

evidence.observation: The speaker introduces referral earnings as commissions from invited people's contributions.
evidence.quote: When you invite people, you get a small commission from their contribution.

evidence.observation: The speaker claims receipt of partner platform payments, described as 100%, conditional on having the corresponding purchased platform open. This is a payment-allocation claim, not a verified investment yield.
evidence.quote: with each platform opened by your partners in the team you will obtain a money 100% But only if you have the platform, purchased by a partner, also open.

evidence.observation: The speaker requires registration and initial platform purchases, priced at 0.05 ETH and described as approximately $10 at the stated current exchange rate.
evidence.quote: To take part in F4SH, you need to register and buy the very first platforms. This costs 0.05 ETH or about $10 for the current course.

evidence.observation: The speaker distinguishes the 0.05 ETH participation purchase from an additional gas cost.
evidence.quote: For this, you will need 0.05 ETH and you will pay for gas.

evidence.observation: The speaker instructs viewers to share a link and build a structure to earn ethers.
evidence.quote: Share this link and create a structure to earn many many ethers.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes an X3 matrix with three places and an X4 matrix with two places in its first line and four in its second.
evidence.quote: In the program ForceHX3 there has been one line for three places. In the program ForceHX4 there two lines for two places in the first line and four places in the second.

evidence.observation: The speaker describes the third partner's placement as triggering reinvestment that reopens the same platform. The wording does not establish a precise investment yield.
evidence.quote: third partner occupies the 3rd place under you you again get 100% income but already in the form of reinvestment and reinvest in turn opens you the same platform again

evidence.observation: The speaker describes three payments going directly to the participant's wallet and a final payment closing the platform and triggering reinvestment.
evidence.quote: Of these 3 payments are directly going to your wallet. The last payment closes the platform and also makes a reinvestment.

evidence.observation: The speaker states that platforms must be opened sequentially rather than purchasing a later platform immediately.
evidence.quote: Remember, one need to understand that the platforms can be opened only in order. You just can not simply buy a 5 th ground right away.

evidence.observation: The speaker lists ETH-denominated platform prices beginning at 0.025 ETH and ending at 51.2 ETH.
evidence.quote: They are different in price starting from 0.025 ETH, then 0.05 ETH, 0.1 ETH, 0.2 ETH and so on to the last one of 51.2 ETH.

evidence.quote: completely 100 percent decentralized! No greedy admins or delay payments, no unforeseen scam, everything is open and transparent.

evidence.observation: The speaker closes with an explicit reminder of crypto-investment risk.
evidence.quote: always remember about risk when investing in crypto projects.
